function.description: Execute a REAL on-chain swap on Uniswap. SPENDS FUNDS: it signs and broadcasts from your wallet. APPROVAL: over MCP in a restricted project the call WAITS until the user answers the Vex card, which IS the confirmation - do not ask for one again in chat. It returns the settled outcome: executed (this tool's own status: confirmed, confirmed_unrecorded or pending - poll it, never re-send), declined, expired, refused, dispatch_failed or indeterminate; never call it twice while you wait; never retry an indeterminate one. In a full project it executes directly under standing permission. Call it only after a fresh matching SwapQuoteUniswap on the SAME venue, the only quote that authorizes this tool - a KyberSwap or namespaced quote cannot. EVM ONLY, on the EVM chains with a verified Vex Uniswap deployment. `amountIn` is the HUMAN decimal of tokenIn. Restricted approval shows chain, token addresses, human `amountIn`, and the quote/floor with its quote-time contract-read output symbol; it omits decimals and atomic input. Its QUOTE-TIME spendability line carries the source-token requirement and the total native debit including every fee leg and the reserve; it is disclosure, not the check, and it is not a live balance. Execution re-reads both token contracts before signing; the card is not proof. Full permission shows no card. BALANCE IS RE-READ HERE AND THAT READ IS THE AUTHORITY, not the quote's: before EACH signature the input-token and native balances are read again at the pending block and must cover that transaction, every transaction still authorized after it (the fee transfer included) and a measured follow-up reserve. Else it refuses with NOTHING signed and nothing broadcast, stating required, held and missing and distinguishing a wallet that is SHORT from a balance that could not be READ; one executable minutes ago is not a guarantee here. Returns the transaction hash and the resulting wallet deltas; failed and pending attempts are recorded and shown with chain + tx hash + explorer link, same as confirmed ones.
function.name: SwapExecuteUniswap

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn to swap, in HUMAN decimal units (e.g. "1.5"). Not wei.

chain.description: EVM chain to swap on (ethereum, base, arbitrum, robinhood, …) - Uniswap ONLY, no venue routing. Solana is NOT supported by this tool.

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (1 bps = 0.01%); default 100 = 1%, which fits deep, liquid pairs. It is the ONLY price protection on the trade. Pass the SAME value to the quote and the execute, or omit it on both - a mismatch blocks the execute. On a thin or volatile pair (new listings, memecoins, small pools) 100 bps often fails. When it fails, the message says so and names this parameter: re-quote with a higher slippageBps and pass the same value to the execute. Do not read a slippage failure as "this pair is untradeable" and do not switch venue for it - another venue at 100 bps fails the same way. Vex caps it at 1000 (10%) and REJECTS anything above rather than clamping; every increase widens the worst-case price you accept, so raise it in steps.

tokenIn.description: Input token: the token CONTRACT ADDRESS or native ETH/native. For an EVM token, call TokenFind with exactly one target chain and continue only when mutationReady is true. Ambiguous, provider-capped, or metadata-unreadable results are not executable identities. If the swap pair is already known, prefer its exact base or quote token address and use TokenFind to validate that address on the target chain. TokenFind reads symbol and decimals from the contract, never provider list metadata.
